paras_en: September 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. equities posted a fourth consecutive losing day on Thursday as the Israel‑Hamas war entered its seventh month. International oil prices surged about 7% in a single day, stoking inflation and rate‑hike concerns, while the yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury broke 4.95%, the highest level since October 2023, hitting high‑valuation tech and semiconductor stocks hardest.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 316.56 points, or 0.60%, to close at 52,064.10; the S&P 500 slipped 0.58% to 7,591.70; and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.65% to 26,081.72. All three major indices recorded their fourth straight decline.

The biggest pressure on the market remains energy prices. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude jumped 7.1% on Thursday, settling at $102.93 per barrel, while the benchmark Brent crude rose 7% to $108.28 per barrel.

Since the Israel‑Hamas conflict erupted at the end of February, WTI has risen a cumulative 52.9%, and it is up 78.5% since the start of 2026. The rapid rise in energy costs not only lifts corporate expenses but also deepens worries about a resurgence of inflation.

Higher oil prices also pushed bond yields up. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield broke 4.95% on Thursday, reaching its highest level since October 2023. For technology and growth stocks, higher yields mean lower discounted future earnings, and rising corporate financing costs add further valuation pressure.
Risk‑off sentiment intensified. The Chicago Board Options Exchange Volatility Index (VIX), known as Wall Street’s “fear gauge,” jumped 8.38% in a day to 17.84.
The latest inflation data added to market strain. U.S. producer price index (PPI) for August rose 0.4% month‑over‑month and 5.4% year‑over‑year, above the revised July annual rate of 4.8%.

Excluding food, energy and trade services, August’s PPI rose 0.3% month‑over‑month and 4.7% year‑over‑year. Energy prices alone rose 4.2% for the month, with diesel surging 24.1%, showing that higher oil prices are translating into corporate cost pressures and heightening focus on the Fed’s next rate decision.

Technology and semiconductor stocks therefore faced the main selling pressure. Intel (INTC‑US) tumbled more than 5.5%, and Micron Technology (MU‑US) fell 4.9%. Investors fear that simultaneous rises in energy prices, rates and financing costs could curb economic activity and corporate cap‑ex, further dampening demand for the tech sector.

European markets were similarly under pressure. The European Central Bank raised its three main policy rates by 25 basis points on Thursday and warned that ongoing geopolitical conflicts continue to fuel inflation. The STOXX Europe 600 slipped 0.69% to 635.97 points, the UK FTSE 100 fell 0.57%, Germany’s DAX 40 dropped 0.84%, and France’s CAC 40 declined 0.49%.

items.title: 【摺疊手機產業】研究機構預測出爐！滲透率不到3%，蘋果能改變嗎？
items.title_en: Foldable Phone Industry: Research Forecast Released! Penetration Below 3%, Can Apple Change It?
paras: 2026年09月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)正式進軍摺疊手機市場，新款iPhone Duo以$1,999起跳，最高儲存容量版本售價更達$3,199。儘管產品規格與品牌號召力可望帶動首波買氣，但分析師認為，蘋果尚未清楚回答一個關鍵問題：除了高消費能力的科技愛好者之外，究竟誰會願意為這款高價摺疊手機買單？
蘋果在美國加州庫比蒂諾發表iPhone Duo，展示Zoom、Slack及Netflix等應用程式在展開後大螢幕上的使用情境，涵蓋工作、內容創作與娛樂。蘋果新任執行長John Ternus也強調，iPhone Duo更大的顯示器具有類似iPad的直覺操作體驗，可望讓手機進一步成為使用者的個人AI中樞。
不過，市場研究機構認為，蘋果對iPhone Duo的定位仍不夠明確。Creative Strategies分析師Carolina Milanesi指出，蘋果過去通常不會明確定義產品買家，但這次尤其迴避這項問題。
Counterpoint Research副總裁Neil Shah也認為，從產品發表內容來看，iPhone Duo究竟主要鎖定工作或娛樂用途並不清楚。不過，iPhone長期以來本來就是強調多用途的裝置，這可能成為蘋果採取廣泛產品定位的理由。
高達$1,999的入門價格，則可能成為iPhone Duo擴大市場規模的最大障礙。蘋果最高儲存容量版本在美國售價達$3,199，意味首波消費族群可能高度集中於高所得用戶、科技產品早期採用者，以及忠實蘋果用戶。
這也讓市場聯想到Vision Pro。蘋果2023年推出Vision Pro擴增實境頭戴裝置時，同樣獲得市場對技術能力的肯定，但高昂價格以及娛樂之外缺乏明確使用情境，使市場對其大規模普及能力抱持疑慮。
然而，iPhone龐大的既有用戶基礎仍可能讓iPhone Duo在上市初期交出亮眼銷售成績。
Counterpoint預估，受既有iPhone用戶累積需求帶動，蘋果截至2026年底仍可能售出接近6百萬支iPhone Duo。光靠這項銷售規模，就足以讓蘋果取得全球摺疊手機約25%市占率。
目前摺疊手機市場仍屬智慧型手機中的利基市場。IDC預估，2026年摺疊手機占全球智慧型手機市場比重仍不到3%，即使蘋果加入推廣，2027年占比也不會出現太大變化。
另一方面，Omdia預估2026年全球摺疊智慧型手機出貨量為2,230萬支，而蘋果加入市場，可望推動摺疊手機產業出現2021年以來最大的年增幅。
這意味如果Counterpoint預估的接近6百萬支成真，iPhone Duo不僅將成為蘋果新的高階產品線，也可能明顯改變目前摺疊手機市場的品牌版圖。
三星電子Samsung Electronics(005930-KR)自2019年開始銷售摺疊手機，目前仍以40%市占率居市場領先地位。Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google以及華為也已推出相關產品，使蘋果進入的是一個技術逐漸成熟、但消費需求仍待突破的市場。

paras_en: September 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Apple (AAPL-US) officially entered the foldable phone market with the new iPhone Duo, starting at $1,999 and reaching $3,199 for the highest‑storage version. While the specs and brand appeal are expected to drive the initial wave of demand, analysts say Apple has not clearly answered a key question: beyond tech‑savvy consumers with high spending power, who will actually pay for this premium foldable phone?

Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo in Cupertino, California, demonstrating how apps such as Zoom, Slack and Netflix work on the expanded screen for work, content creation and entertainment. New CEO John Ternus emphasized that the larger display offers an iPad‑like intuitive experience, positioning the phone as a personal AI hub for users.

However, market research firms say Apple’s positioning of the iPhone Duo remains unclear. Creative Strategies analyst Carolina Milanesi noted that Apple usually does not define a specific buyer persona, and this time it is especially avoiding the issue.

Counterpoint Research vice‑president Neil Shah also said the launch materials do not make it clear whether the iPhone Duo is aimed primarily at work or entertainment. Yet the iPhone has long been marketed as a multipurpose device, which may justify Apple’s broad positioning approach.

The $1,999 entry price could be the biggest obstacle to scaling the iPhone Duo’s market. The top‑storage model sells for $3,199 in the United States, suggesting the first wave of buyers will be high‑income users, early adopters of tech products, and loyal Apple fans.

This draws parallels to the Vision Pro. When Apple launched the Vision Pro AR headset in 2023, it received praise for its technology but its steep price and lack of clear use cases beyond entertainment raised doubts about mass adoption.
Nevertheless, the iPhone’s massive existing user base could still deliver strong early sales for the iPhone Duo.

Counterpoint estimates that, driven by accumulated demand from existing iPhone users, Apple could sell close to 6 million iPhone Duo units by the end of 2026. Even that volume alone would give Apple roughly a 25% share of the global foldable phone market.

The foldable phone market remains a niche within smartphones. IDC projects that foldables will account for less than 3% of the global smartphone market in 2026, and even with Apple’s entry, the share is not expected to change much in 2027.
Meanwhile, Omdia forecasts global foldable smartphone shipments at 22.3 million units in 2026, and Apple’s entry could drive the industry’s biggest annual growth rate since 2021.

That means if Counterpoint’s near‑6‑million‑unit estimate materializes, the iPhone Duo will not only become a new high‑end product line for Apple but could also noticeably reshape the brand landscape of the foldable phone market.

Samsung Electronics (005930-KR) has been selling foldable phones since 2019 and still leads the market with a 40% share. Alphabet’s Google and Huawei have also launched related products, meaning Apple is entering a market where technology is maturing but consumer demand still needs to be unlocked.

items.title: Astra需求爆量！OpenAI暫停200美元專業版訂閱服務
items.title_en: Astra Demand Surges! OpenAI Pauses $200 Pro Plan Subscriptions
paras: 多家外媒週四 (10日) 報導，OpenAI最新模型GPT-6 Astra上線後需求大幅超出預期，對公司運算基礎設施形成壓力。為優先維持既有用戶的服務品質，OpenAI宣布暫停每月200美元Pro 20X方案的新用戶訂閱，已訂閱用戶則不受影響。
負責Codex與ChatGPT等核心產品的OpenAI產品主管Tibo Sottiaux在社群平台X表示，Pro 20X用戶使用的系統資源最多，因此公司決定先停止接受該方案的新訂戶。
這項調整是OpenAI在需求迅速增加之際，為維持GPT-6 Astra存取穩定度所採取的限制措施。
Sottiaux在前一天便透露，GPT-6 Astra的需求達到前所未見的程度。
儘管OpenAI正採取各種方式增加服務能力，需求成長速度仍超越公司過去經歷的高成長階段。他當時已預告，若情況持續，OpenAI可能暫停Pro方案新訂閱，並將確保現有用戶獲得良好服務列為優先目標。
此次限制僅針對Pro 20X方案的新訂戶。
應用程式介面 (API) 仍可正常使用，價格較低的Go與Plus方案也繼續接受訂閱。
OpenAI尚未說明何時恢復Pro 20X新用戶註冊，也未公布每日訂閱需求的具體規模。
OpenAI於9月3日推出GPT-6 Astra，之後陸續向Pro、Plus、Enterprise及Business方案用戶開放。
公司將Astra定位為推理、程式設計及電腦操作能力的一次重大躍進，並宣稱這次發布象徵「通用人工智慧 (AGI) 時代」的開始，帶動市場關注與使用需求快速升高。
OpenAI上月才提高Codex用戶的使用上限，如今便因Astra需求暴增而暫停最高階方案的新訂閱，顯示新模型帶來大量使用需求的同時，也進一步考驗OpenAI的運算資源與基礎設施承載能力。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported on Thursday (the 10th) that demand for OpenAI’s latest model GPT‑6 Astra far exceeded expectations after its launch, putting pressure on the company’s computing infrastructure. To prioritize service quality for existing users, OpenAI announced it will suspend new subscriptions to the $200‑per‑month Pro 20X plan, while current subscribers will not be affected.

OpenAI product lead Tibo Sottiaux, who oversees core products such as Codex and ChatGPT, said on the social platform X that Pro 20X users consume the most system resources, so the company decided to stop accepting new customers for that tier first.
The adjustment is a throttling measure OpenAI is taking amid rapidly rising demand to maintain stable access to GPT‑6 Astra.
Sottiaux disclosed the day before that demand for GPT‑6 Astra had reached unprecedented levels.

Although OpenAI is employing various methods to boost service capacity, the growth rate of demand still outpaces any high‑growth period the company has previously experienced. He had previously warned that if the situation persisted, OpenAI might suspend new subscriptions to the Pro plan and would prioritize ensuring good service for existing users.
The restriction applies only to new customers of the Pro 20X plan.
The API remains fully operational, and lower‑priced Go and Plus plans continue to accept new subscriptions.
OpenAI has not indicated when it will reopen Pro 20X registrations for new users, nor has it disclosed the exact daily subscription demand volume.
OpenAI launched GPT‑6 Astra on September 3, subsequently rolling it out to users of the Pro, Plus, Enterprise and Business tiers.

The company positions Astra as a major leap in reasoning, programming, and computer‑operation capabilities, claiming the release marks the beginning of the “Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) era,” which has spurred heightened market attention and rapidly rising usage demand.

OpenAI raised usage limits for Codex users just last month; now, due to the surge in Astra demand, it is pausing new subscriptions to its highest‑tier plan, highlighting how the new model’s massive uptake is testing the firm’s computing resources and infrastructure capacity.

items.title: 蘋果iPhone Duo買氣有隱憂？Jefferies點名兩大潛在勸退因素
items.title_en: Apple iPhone Duo Sales Face Concerns? Jefferies Flags Two Potential Deterrents
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 正式亮相，但分析師認為，過大的機身可能不利於手掌較小的消費者操作，加上供應鏈傳出蘋果明年將推出一般尺寸的第二代摺疊機，可能使部分果粉延後換機，成為新品上市後的兩大考驗。
外媒報導，Jefferies 分析師 Edison Lee 週四在報告中指出，iPhone Duo 雖具話題性，但市場是否偏好這種尺寸仍有待觀察。對手掌較小的使用者而言，單手握持手機並操作螢幕較為困難，可能影響實際使用體驗。
iPhone Duo 採用類似護照的書本式摺疊設計，機身外側配備 5.4 吋螢幕，展開後則為 7.6 吋大螢幕，適合觀看影片、玩遊戲、工作及多工處理。不過，對於多年來習慣單手打字、滑動頁面及操作 iPhone 的用戶而言，較大的機身也可能帶來不便。
除了尺寸問題，下一代產品預期也可能壓抑首代機型買氣。
Lee 引述供應鏈調查指出，蘋果可能在明年推出一般尺寸的第二代摺疊手機，售價甚至可能更高。
這意味 iPhone Duo 或許只是一款過渡性的單代產品，部分消費者可能因此選擇等待下一代機型。
iPhone Duo 售價自 1,999 美元 (台幣 74,900 元)起，最高規格版本價格約達 3,199 美元 (台幣118,900 元)。這款新機由蘋果新任執行長特納斯在年度新品發表會上揭曉，被視為公司正式進軍摺疊手機市場的重要一步。
不過，AT&T 執行長 John Stankey 認為，iPhone Duo 尚未展現足以徹底改變市場的創新。他表示，摺疊手機並非全新概念，Android 陣營近年已推出多款表現不俗的產品，但實際市場反應顯示，這類裝置仍較偏向特定族群使用，尚未獲得廣泛消費者接受。
蘋果 (AAPL-US)股價在新品發表會當天小幅收低，週四強彈 3.56% 至每股 326.57 美元。
華爾街多頭看好蘋果 (AAPL-US) 迎來新產品週期，摺疊 iPhone、高階機種與 AI 功能有望成為下一階段成長動能。美銀、HSBC與Evercore ISI均維持正面評級，最高目標價達 380 美元，認為蘋果有能力憑藉定價權與強勁需求化解成本及供應鏈壓力。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) unveiled its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, but analysts warn that its large size may be unwieldy for users with smaller hands, and supply‑chain reports that Apple will launch a standard‑sized second‑generation foldable next year could cause some fans to postpone upgrades, posing two major challenges after launch.

Foreign media reported that Jefferies analyst Edison Lee said on Thursday in a note that while the iPhone Duo is attention‑grabbing, it remains to be seen whether the market prefers this size. For users with smaller palms, holding the phone with one hand and operating the screen is more difficult, potentially affecting the real‑world experience.

The iPhone Duo uses a passport‑style book fold, with a 5.4‑inch outer screen and a 7.6‑inch inner display when opened, suitable for video, gaming, work and multitasking. However, for users accustomed for years to one‑hand typing, scrolling and operating an iPhone, the larger body may also be inconvenient.
Beyond the size issue, expectations for a next‑generation product could also suppress demand for the first‑generation model.
Lee cited a supply‑chain survey indicating Apple may launch a standard‑sized second‑generation foldable phone next year, possibly at an even higher price point.
This suggests the iPhone Duo might be a transitional, single‑generation product, leading some consumers to wait for the next model.

The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999 (NT$74,900) and the top‑spec version reaches about $3,199 (NT$118,900). The new device was unveiled by Apple’s new CEO Tim Cook at the annual product event and is seen as a key step in the company’s formal entry into the foldable‑phone market.

However, AT&T CEO John Stankey said the iPhone Duo has not yet shown enough innovation to fundamentally change the market. He noted that foldable phones are not a brand‑new concept, with Android rivals having released several strong products in recent years, but market response shows these devices still appeal mainly to niche groups and have not achieved broad consumer acceptance.
Apple’s (AAPL-US) stock slipped slightly on the day of the product launch but rebounded on Thursday, jumping 3.56% to $326.57 per share.

Wall Street bulls are optimistic that Apple (AAPL-US) is entering a new product cycle, with the foldable iPhone, high‑end models and AI features expected to drive the next growth phase. Bank of America, HSBC and Evercore ISI all maintain positive ratings, with target prices up to $380, believing Apple can leverage pricing power and strong demand to offset cost and supply‑chain pressures.

items.title_en: Oil Prices Break $100! Global Bond Market Triggers New Sell‑off as US and UK Long‑Term Yields Hit Near 20‑Year Highs
paras: 中東局勢升溫引發原油供應疑慮，國際油價週四 (10 日) 大漲逾6%、突破每桶107美元，再度點燃市場對通膨升溫及央行升息的擔憂。投資人拋售主要經濟體政府公債，美國、英國及歐元區殖利率同步攀升，其中美國30年期與英國10年期公債殖利率均創2007年以來新高。
這波賣壓的直接導火線，是胡塞武裝沿葉門紅海沿岸推進，市場擔心沙烏地阿拉伯原油出口可能受阻。油價在美伊戰事恢復後原已持續上漲，最新漲勢進一步加深通膨可能延續的疑慮，也提高各國央行繼續收緊貨幣政策的壓力。
西德州原油 (WTI) 週四飆漲6.7%，收在每桶102.48美元；布蘭特原油勁揚6.3%，收在每桶107.63美元，兩大指標油價均創5月19日以來最高收盤價。
美國債市首當其衝。10年期美債殖利率盤中上升逾11個基點至4.954%，創2023年10月26日以來最高，距離5%關卡僅一步之遙。
10年期殖利率也是房貸、汽車貸款及信用卡利率的重要定價基準。美國 30 年期固定房貸平均利率週四突破 7%。
對聯準會 (Fed) 短期政策較敏感的2年期美債殖利率週四上升逾13個基點，最高觸及4.56%，創2024年7月以來新高；30年期美債殖利率則上升逾8個基點至5.368%，來到2007年以來最高水準。(債券價格與殖利率走勢相反。)
美國8月生產者物價指數 (PPI) 月增0.4%，符合市場預期；排除食品及能源後，核心PPI月增0.2%，低於預估的0.3%。不過，投資人更關注油價上漲對未來通膨與利率的影響，相對溫和的物價數據未能扭轉債市賣壓。
美國財政部的公債回購也未能明顯壓低殖利率。財長貝森特原先宣布回購最多60億美元長天期公債，財政部週四實際買回近52億美元的非指標10年期及20年期公債，約占投資人提出105億美元賣回規模的一半。
回購集中於少數持有人，可能主要來自一級交易商，顯示這項操作著重改善特定區段的市場流動性，而非大規模承接政府債券。回購結果公布後，美債殖利率大致維持原有水準。
Capital.com資深金融市場分析師Kyle Rodda指出，要讓長期殖利率持續下降，仍須仰賴總體經濟政策出現實質轉變，例如美國政府縮減支出，或Fed進一步升息。TD Securities形容，債市正遭遇油價上漲及期限溢價升高的「雙重打擊」。
另一方面，美國30年期公債標售需求優於預期，仍未能扭轉整體跌勢。
BMO Capital Markets指出，本次標售得標殖利率較投標截止前市場水準低2.7個基點，非交易商投標占比達97.8%，高於過去6次增額發行平均的88.5%。
債市賣壓也蔓延至歐洲。
2年期英債殖利率大漲18個基點至4.88%。10年期英債殖利率升破5.37%，創2007年以來最高，進一步壓縮政府財政空間。
借貸成本升高不僅將增加未來投資計畫的融資負擔，油氣價格上漲也可能迫使英國政府在冬季提供更多家庭支援。
歐洲央行 (ECB) 同日將將存款利率上調1碼至2.5%，預估核心通膨率2026年將達2.5%、2027年進一步升至2.6%，均高於2%目標。
決策公布後，歐元區公債殖利率續創多年高點。德國10年期公債殖利率上升6個基點至3.5%，創15年新高。交易員認為，若能源價格持續攀升，歐洲央行12月可能再次升息。
ECB總裁拉加德表示，通膨持續時間可能比原先預期更久，中東衝突仍在製造通膨壓力，物價漲幅將在一段較長時間內高於央行目標。
市場接下來將聚焦週五公布的美國消費者物價指數 (CPI)，以進一步判斷通膨走勢及Fed下週利率決策。
英國央行也將於下週召開會議，市場目前預期其將維持3.75%的政策利率不變，繼續觀察油價上漲對經濟與物價的影響。
paras_en: The escalation of tensions in the Middle East has raised concerns about oil supply, sending international crude prices soaring more than 6% on Thursday (the 10th) to over $107 a barrel, reigniting worries about rising inflation and central‑bank rate hikes. Investors dumped sovereign bonds of major economies, pushing US, UK and euro‑area yields higher, with the US 30‑year and UK 10‑year yields reaching their highest levels since 2007.

The immediate trigger for this selling pressure was the advance of Houthi forces along Yemen’s Red Sea coast, prompting fears that Saudi oil exports could be disrupted. Oil prices, which had already been climbing since the resumption of US‑Iran hostilities, rose further, deepening concerns that inflation could persist and increasing pressure on central banks to keep tightening monetary policy.
West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude jumped 6.7% on Thursday, closing at $102.48 a barrel, while Brent crude surged 6.3% to $107.63 a barrel, both marking the highest close since May 19.

The US bond market felt the brunt first. The 10‑year Treasury yield rose more than 11 basis points intraday to 4.954%, the highest since October 26, 2023, and now just a hair away from the 5% threshold.

The 10‑year yield also serves as a key pricing benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit‑card rates. The average rate on a 30‑year fixed‑rate mortgage in the United States broke the 7% mark on Thursday.

The 2‑year Treasury yield, which is more sensitive to the Fed’s short‑term policy, climbed over 13 basis points on Thursday, peaking at 4.56% – a new high since July 2024; the 30‑year yield rose more than 8 basis points to 5.368%, the highest level since 2007. (Bond prices move inversely to yields.)

The US August Producer Price Index (PPI) rose 0.4% month‑on‑month, in line with expectations; core PPI, which excludes food and energy, increased 0.2% month‑on‑month, below the 0.3% forecast. Nevertheless, investors remain more focused on how higher oil prices will affect future inflation and rates, and the relatively modest price data did not reverse the bond‑sell pressure.

The Treasury’s bond buy‑back program also failed to pull yields down noticeably. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen had initially announced a repurchase of up to $6 billion of long‑dated securities; on Thursday the Treasury actually bought back nearly $5.2 billion of non‑benchmark 10‑year and 20‑year bonds, roughly half of the $10.5 billion sell‑back size investors had offered.

The repurchases were concentrated among a few holders, likely primary dealers, indicating the operation was aimed at improving liquidity in specific segments rather than absorbing a large volume of government debt. After the buy‑back results were disclosed, US Treasury yields largely held their previous levels.

Senior market analyst Kyle Rodda of Capital.com said that for long‑term yields to keep falling, a substantive shift in overall economic policy is needed, such as reduced US government spending or further Fed rate hikes. TD Securities described the bond market as being hit by a “dual blow” of rising oil prices and widening term premiums.
On the other hand, demand for the US 30‑year Treasury auction was stronger than expected, but it was still insufficient to reverse the overall downward trend.

BMO Capital Markets noted that the auction’s winning yield was 2.7 basis points lower than the market level before the bidding deadline, with non‑dealer participation accounting for 97.8% of bids, above the 88.5% average of the past six supplemental issuances.
The bond‑selling pressure has also spread to Europe.
The UK 2‑year gilt yield jumped 18 basis points to 4.88%. The 10‑year gilt yield rose past 5.37%, the highest since 2007, further tightening the government’s fiscal space.

Higher borrowing costs will not only increase financing burdens for future investment projects, but rising oil and gas prices may also force the UK government to provide additional household support during the winter.
The European Central Bank (ECB) on the same day raised its deposit rate by one tick to 2.5%, projecting core inflation to reach 2.5% in 2026 and 2.6% in 2027, both above its 2% target.

After the policy decision, euro‑area sovereign yields continued to hit multi‑year highs. Germany’s 10‑year bund yield rose 6 basis points to 3.5%, a 15‑year peak. Traders think that if energy prices keep climbing, the ECB may raise rates again in December.

ECB President Christine Lagarde said that inflation may persist longer than previously expected, with the Middle‑East conflict still generating price pressure, and that price growth will stay above the central bank’s target for an extended period.
Markets will now focus on the US Consumer Price Index (CPI) to be released on Friday, which will help gauge inflation trends and the Fed’s rate decision next week.

The Bank of England is also set to meet next week; markets currently expect it to keep its policy rate unchanged at 3.75% while it continues to monitor the impact of rising oil prices on the economy and inflation.

items.title: 【工業機器人】AI大咖開始搶進工廠！Google攜手Fanuc，AI焊接12月上市
items.title_en: Industrial Robots: AI Giants Rush Into Factories! Google Teams Up With Fanuc, AI Welding to Launch in December
paras: 2026年09月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI開始加速進入工廠生產現場。日本工業機器人大廠發那科Fanuc(6954-JP)將與Google合作開發AI自動焊接機器人，預計今年12月推出自動焊接系統，並計畫將應用範圍擴大至電子零組件、家具等產業。
過去工業機器人擅長的是固定位置、固定動作的重複工作，但AI結合機器視覺後，機器人可以辨識工件位置、方向與外觀差異，再即時調整移動軌跡。這對焊接尤其重要，因為不同工件的形狀、位置與焊道可能存在差異，導入AI與3D視覺後，有機會降低重新設定與編程的需求，讓自動焊接更容易導入多樣化的生產環境。
這項合作的重點，在於AI應用正從生成式AI與資料中心，進一步延伸至工業自動化。焊接過去高度仰賴技術人員設定與操作，若透過AI提高機器人辨識、判斷與自動化能力，可望降低導入門檻，讓機器人更容易應用於不同產品與生產環境。
Fanuc計畫將這套系統推廣至更多產業，也意味AI機器人的市場不再侷限汽車等傳統高度自動化領域，而有機會進一步切入電子零組件、家具等製造場景。後續值得追蹤12月產品上市後的實際客戶導入，以及AI功能能否進一步帶動工業機器人訂單。

paras_en: September 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI is accelerating its entry into factory production sites. Japanese industrial robot leader Fanuc (6954-JP) will partner with Google to develop an AI-powered automatic welding robot, slated to launch an automatic welding system in December this year, with plans to expand its application scope to electronics components, furniture and other industries.

Historically, industrial robots excel at fixed‑position, repetitive tasks, but with AI combined with machine vision, robots can recognize workpiece location, orientation and visual differences, then adjust their motion paths in real time. This is especially crucial for welding, where variations in part shape, position and weld bead can exist; AI and 3D vision can reduce the need for re‑setting and re‑programming, making automatic welding easier to deploy across diverse production environments.

The focus of this collaboration is that AI applications are moving from generative AI and data centers into industrial automation. Welding has traditionally relied heavily on skilled technicians for setup and operation; by using AI to enhance robot perception, judgment and automation, the entry barrier could be lowered, allowing robots to be more readily applied to different products and production settings.

Fanuc plans to promote this system to more industries, indicating that the AI robot market will no longer be confined to traditional highly automated sectors such as automotive, but could further penetrate manufacturing scenes like electronics components and furniture. It will be worth tracking actual customer adoption after the product launch in December and whether the AI features can further drive industrial robot orders.

paras: 巴克萊表示，如果市場對日本央行加快升息，以及日本退休基金將資金轉向國內資產的預期未能實現，日元近期的急升走勢可能逆轉，兌美元恐回落至150區間高檔。
包括Shinichiro Kadota在內的策略師周四(10日)在報告中指出，日元近期走強，主要受到日本央行收緊貨幣政策的預期、退休基金資金流向的揣測，以及技術面因素推動。儘管美元兌日元跌破155附近的關鍵支撐，短期仍可能進一步走低，但長期壓抑日元的結構性因素大致未變。
日元本月迄今已上漲近4%，升至2月以來最強水準，市場看多情緒持續升溫。投資人對日本央行下周升息的預期增強，加上外界猜測日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能提高日本國內資產配置，進一步帶動日元需求。
美國財長貝森特也向交易員喊話，挑戰市場測試他推升日元的決心，並表示自己「相當清楚」日本決策官員接下來會採取什麼行動。
亞洲周四下午交易時段，日元小幅升值0.1%，報每美元兌153.45日元。
巴克萊警告，市場預期目前已處於高檔，若日元要進一步升值，日本央行可能必須釋出比預期更鷹派的訊號。市場也可能高估GPIF資金流向的潛在影響，若其資產配置最終未出現調整，日元恐面臨走勢逆轉。
此外，巴克萊指出，利差、日本股票風險溢價、外界對首相高市早苗政策的疑慮，以及結構性的日元賣盤，仍不利於日元持續升值。
paras_en: Barclays says that if market expectations of a faster rate‑hike cycle by the Bank of Japan and of Japanese pension funds shifting money into domestic assets fail to materialise, the yen’s recent sharp rise could reverse, with the dollar‑yen possibly slipping back into the high‑150s range.

Strategists, including Shinichiro Kadota, noted on Thursday (the 10th) that the yen’s recent strength has been driven mainly by expectations of tighter BOJ policy, speculation about pension fund flows and technical factors. Even though USD/JPY has broken below the key support near 155, it could still drift lower in the short term, but the structural headwinds that keep the yen subdued remain largely unchanged.

The yen is up almost 4% so far this month, reaching its strongest level since February, as bullish sentiment heats up. Investors’ expectations of a BOJ rate hike next week have risen, and speculation that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may increase its allocation to domestic assets is further boosting yen demand.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen also called out traders, challenging the market to test her resolve to support the yen, and said she is “quite clear” about what Japanese policymakers are likely to do next.
In the Asian afternoon trading session on Thursday, the yen edged up 0.1% to 153.45 per dollar.

Barclays warns that market expectations are already at elevated levels; for the yen to rise further the BOJ may need to signal a more hawkish stance than anticipated. The market may also be over‑estimating the impact of GPIF flows, and if the fund’s asset allocation does not adjust, the yen could see its rally reverse.

Barclays also points out that interest‑rate differentials, risk premiums on Japanese equities, concerns about Prime Minister Kishida’s policies, and structural yen‑selling pressure remain headwinds to any sustained yen appreciation.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 PPI推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Rises as PPI Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周四(10日)上漲，美國年度整體生產者通膨加速，推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期。數據公布後，債券市場跌勢進一步加劇，殖利率大幅攀升，也進一步推高借貸成本。
同時，歐洲央行(ECB)如市場普遍預期升息後，歐元走弱。另一方面，市場預期日本銀行(BoJ)即將收緊貨幣政策，日元此前猛烈漲勢也暫告停歇。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報99.03。
匯市投資人周四焦點集中在美國8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)數據，8月整體PPI月增0.4%、年增5.4%，分別高於市場預期的0.4%與5.3%。此外，7月整體PPI也從原先月增0.1%、年增4.7%，上修至月增0.1%、年增4.8%。
核心PPI則月增0.2%、年增4.6%，市場原先預期分別為月增0.3%與年增4.6%。
PPI報告公布後一天，市場還將迎來受到更高度關注的消費者物價指數(CPI)數據，而就在幾天前，美國才公布表現強勁的8月非農就業報告。綜合這些指標來看，美國勞動市場依然具韌性，同時經濟也受到價格壓力困擾。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策。
這種預期也反映在聯準會利率機率上。根據CME FedWatch工具，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)9月16日升息25個基點的機率，目前已升至73%，高於PPI數據公布前的約64%。
PPI數據公布後，美股走低，美國公債殖利率同步上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期美債殖利率最新上升11.8個基點至4.955%，對利率更加敏感的2年期美債殖利率則上升12.9個基點，至4.556%。
債券市場前一個交易日同樣大幅走弱，因市場高度期待的美國財政部國債回購計畫更新，最終令投資人失望。
此外，油價漲勢周四進一步擴大，加劇市場對通膨的擔憂。美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨價格突破每桶100美元，為5月21日以來首次。油價上漲主要受到美國與伊朗軍事衝突重新升溫推動，雙方此前曾因荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)控制權問題陷入數周僵局。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「與伊朗的戰事正在壓過華府的債券回購努力，因為不斷升高的通膨預期，對區區60億美元的回購規模而言，負擔實在太沉重。」
他表示，「白宮與財政部本身都希望利率下降，但與德黑蘭的衝突升溫，不利於油價穩定與國家預算，因為區域內的暴力攻擊正在干擾原油供應，並推高軍事支出，進而在其他條件不變下擴大財政缺口。」
「此外，這也讓聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)陷入兩難，因固定收益市場實際上正要求聯準會升息，以壓制正在加速的價格壓力。」
ECB升息 日元漲勢暫歇
歐洲央行周四如市場普遍預期，將主要政策利率上調25個基點，並指出中東衝突導致能源價格上漲，持續帶來通膨壓力。
央行在聲明中警告，中東衝突持續「產生通膨壓力」，而通膨率預計將在「一段較長時間內」明顯高於2%的政策目標。
德意志銀行首席歐洲經濟學家Mark Wall表示，「通膨風險可能正在升高，12月進一步升息的可能性或許已經高於不升息，但歐洲央行仍需謹慎行事。過去6個月經濟表現具韌性，但天然氣價格快速上漲意味著負面的供給衝擊正在累積。這最終將傷害經濟成長，問題在於衝擊會有多大，以及何時發生。」
歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)在會後記者會上表示，由伊朗戰爭造成的「能源衝擊」可能進一步加劇，而且對其他商品價格與工資造成的第二輪影響，可能比預期更強。
《彭博》引述知情人士報導，歐洲央行官員預計將進一步升息，最快可能在下個月。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1614美元。
日元周四暫停近期強勁的升值走勢，美元兌日元上漲0.6%，至154.34日元。不過，隨著交易員持續拆解日元利差交易空頭部位，日元仍穩守在7個月高點附近。
貨幣市場普遍預期，日銀將於9月18日升息25個基點。這項預期受到日本第2季GDP成長率上修至1.4%，以及進口通膨維持高位等因素支持。
在官方數據顯示日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元、用於支應匯市干預操作後，市場對東京匯率政策的關注依然高度升溫，其中包括近期與華府同步進行的一項歷史性干預行動。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Thursday (the 10th), as the U.S. annual overall producer price inflation accelerated, lifting expectations for another Federal Reserve rate hike. After the data were released, the bond market fell further, yields surged sharply and borrowing costs rose.

At the same time, the euro weakened after the European Central Bank, as the market broadly expected, raised rates. Conversely, the market expects the Bank of Japan to tighten policy soon, pausing the yen’s recent sharp rally.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.2% at 99.03.
FX investors on Thursday focused on the U.S. August producer price index (PPI) report.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, August overall PPI rose 0.4% month‑on‑month and 5.4% year‑on‑year, both above market expectations of 0.4% and 5.3%. In addition, July overall PPI was revised from a 0.1% monthly gain and 4.7% annual gain to a 0.1% monthly gain and 4.8% annual gain.
Core PPI rose 0.2% month‑on‑month and 4.6% year‑on‑year, versus market expectations of a 0.3% monthly rise and a 4.6% annual rise.

One day after the PPI release, the market will also receive the highly‑watched consumer price index (CPI) data, and just days earlier the U.S. posted a strong August non‑farm payroll report. Taken together, these indicators show that the U.S. labor market remains resilient while the economy is still under price pressure. In such a setting, central banks typically consider tightening monetary policy.

That expectation is reflected in Fed rate‑move probabilities. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the odds of a 25‑basis‑point hike by the Federal Open Market Committee on September 16 have risen to 73%, up from roughly 64% before the PPI data were released.

After the PPI numbers, U.S. equities fell and Treasury yields rose as bonds were sold off. The 10‑year Treasury yield climbed 11.8 basis points to 4.955%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield jumped 12.9 basis points to 4.556%.
The bond market also weakened sharply the previous trading day, after an update to the highly anticipated U.S. Treasury repurchase program disappointed investors.

In addition, oil prices rose further on Thursday, heightening inflation concerns. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures broke the $100‑a‑barrel mark for the first time since May 21. The price gain was driven mainly by a renewed flare‑up in U.S.–Iran military tensions, after both sides spent weeks deadlocked over control of the Strait of Hormuz.

José Torres, a senior economist at Interactive Brokers, said, “The conflict with Iran is outweighing Washington’s bond‑buyback efforts, because the rising inflation expectations make even a $6 billion repurchase program a heavy burden.”

He added, “Both the White House and the Treasury want rates to fall, but the escalating clash with Tehran hurts oil‑price stability and the national budget, as regional violence disrupts crude supply and pushes up military spending, widening the fiscal gap all else equal.”
“Moreover, this puts Fed Chair Kevin Warsh in a bind, because the fixed‑income market is effectively demanding a rate hike to curb accelerating price pressures.”
ECB Rate Hike, Yen Rally Pauses

On Thursday, the European Central Bank, as broadly expected, lifted its main policy rate by 25 basis points and noted that Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price gains continue to feed inflation pressure.

In its statement, the ECB warned that the ongoing Middle‑East conflict is “creating inflationary pressure,” and that inflation is expected to stay “significantly above the 2% target for a prolonged period.”

Mark Wall, chief European economist at Deutsche Bank, said, “Inflation risks may be rising, and the odds of a further hike in December could now be higher than of holding steady, but the ECB must act prudently. The economy has shown resilience over the past six months, yet the rapid rise in gas prices signals a negative supply shock that is building up. That will ultimately hurt growth; the question is how large the shock will be and when it will hit.”

ECB President Christine Lagarde told reporters after the meeting that the “energy shock” from the Iran war could intensify further, and the second‑round effects on other commodity prices and wages may be stronger than expected.
Bloomberg, citing informed sources, reported that ECB officials expect to raise rates again, possibly as early as next month.
The euro fell 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1614.

The yen halted its recent strong appreciation on Thursday, with the dollar‑yen pair up 0.6% at 154.34 yen. Nevertheless, as traders continue to unwind short positions in yen‑carry trades, the currency remains near a seven‑month high.

The money market broadly expects the BOJ to raise rates by 25 basis points on September 18. That view is supported by the revision of Japan’s Q2 GDP growth to 1.4% and persistently high import‑price inflation.

Official data showed Japan’s August foreign‑securities holdings fell by a record $87.8 billion after being used for FX‑intervention, keeping market focus on Tokyo’s policy moves, including a historic coordinated intervention with Washington.

items.title: 通膨壓不住、經濟又怕衰退！歐洲央行利率是否衝3% 分析師吵翻天
items.title_en: Inflation Unchecked, Economy Fears Recession! Will ECB Rates Hit 3%? Analysts Clash
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(10日)如預期升息1碼(25個基點)，將存款利率調高至2.5%，為今年第二度升息，以因應美伊戰爭推升能源價格所帶來的通膨壓力。ECB雖未承諾後續行動，但分析師對本輪升息是否已近尾聲看法不一：部分認為年底前可能再度升息，另一些則警告，能源衝擊終將拖累成長，市場押注利率逼近3%可能過頭。
市場反應方面，歐元兌美元下跌0.3%至約1.159美元，歐元區公債殖利率升至多年高點，歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.7%；油價則大漲逾4%至每桶105.3美元。

鷹派認為升息尚未結束 年底前可能再出手

德意志銀行(DB-US)首席歐洲經濟學家Mark Wall表示，通膨風險正在上升，ECB於12月再次升息的可能性或許已超過按兵不動。不過，ECB仍須謹慎行事，因歐元區經濟過去半年雖展現韌性，天然氣價格迅速上漲造成的負面供給衝擊正逐漸累積，最終勢必傷害成長，問題只在影響程度及何時浮現。
Saltmarsh Economics歐洲經濟學家Marchel Alexandrovich指出，ECB在三個月內第二度升息，並暗示未來幾次會議可能需要進一步緊縮。ECB雖未預先承諾升息，但最新預測顯示，2028年核心通膨仍達2.3%，高於6月預估的2.2%，意味若要讓通膨在中期回到2%目標，可能還需要繼續升息。
摩根大通私人銀行(JPMorgan Private Bank)(JPM-US)宏觀投資策略師Patrick Ernst認為，年底前再升息已不再只是低機率風險。中東衝突再次升級，推動油氣價格明顯上漲、美債遭到拋售，市場對主要央行繼續緊縮的預期也同步升高。
Ernst表示，ECB本次升息符合預期，但真正重要的是決策聲明仍為進一步緊縮保留空間，顯示能源引發的通膨風險依然存在，「這次升息並不是利率上限」，後續走向將高度取決於地緣政治局勢。
標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)(SPGI-US)歐洲、中東及非洲首席經濟學家Sylvain Broyer也表示，這次升息不只是預防性措施。歐洲通膨前景在夏季期間已經惡化，不僅供給衝擊增加，需求也愈來愈可能推升物價，因此ECB可能必須把利率調至具有限制性的水準，現階段不能排除繼續升息。

成長風險逐漸浮現 市場押注3%恐怕過頭

施羅德(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees則持較審慎看法。他指出，能源價格上漲將使整體通膨維持高檔，但核心通膨目前仍受控制，內需也正在轉弱；能源與融資成本同步上升，可能進一步壓抑歐元區經濟，2027年受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
Rees認為，儘管ECB聲明及經濟預測偏向鷹派，但再次升息的門檻仍高，本次行動更像本輪最後一次升息，而非長期升息周期的起點。除非經濟成長與通膨再次顯著加速，市場不應直接認定利率將朝3%邁進。
Quilter Cheviot固定收益研究主管Richard Carter表示，ECB面臨的平衡難題愈來愈棘手。歐元區部分地區成長仍然脆弱，決策官員必須在抑制通膨與避免進一步打擊經濟之間權衡。停滯性通膨雖尚未成為基本情境，但成長轉弱與通膨壓力重燃的組合，已愈來愈難以忽視。
Aviva Investors利率主管Ed Hutchings認為，ECB眼前首要任務確實是控制通膨，因此市場預期還會升息並非沒有道理。不過，在ECB已升息兩次、市場又反映超過兩次後續升息的情況下，投資人的緊縮押注可能已走得太遠。
富達國際(Fidelity International)歐元區經濟學家Conor Parle則提醒，天然氣及燃料價格上漲將促使ECB密切觀察物價壓力是否擴散。近期熱浪及供應鏈影響可能推高食品通膨，薪資追蹤指標也顯示薪資成長略微加速，決策官員將關注是否出現能源衝擊擴散至其他價格的早期跡象。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) on Thursday (the 10th) raised rates as expected by one quarter-point (25 basis points), lifting the deposit rate to 2.5%, marking its second hike this year to counter inflation pressure from higher energy prices driven by the US‑Iran war. The ECB did not pledge further action, and analysts are divided on whether this round of tightening is near its end: some think another hike could come before year‑end, while others warn that the energy shock will eventually drag down growth and that markets may be over‑betting on rates approaching 3%.

In market reaction, the euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to about $1.159, euro‑area sovereign yields rose to multi‑year highs, the European Stoxx 600 slipped 0.7%, and oil surged more than 4% to $105.3 a barrel.

Hawkish voices say the tightening is not over and another move may come before year‑end. Deutsche Bank (DB‑US) chief European economist Mark Wall said inflation risks are rising and the odds that the ECB will hike again in December may now exceed the odds of holding steady. Still, the ECB must act cautiously because, although the euro‑area economy has shown resilience over the past six months, the negative supply shock from rapidly rising natural‑gas prices is accumulating and will eventually hurt growth; the question is how severe and when it will materialise.

Saltmarsh Economics European economist Marchel Alexandrovich noted that the ECB’s second hike within three months hints that further tightening may be needed in upcoming meetings. While the ECB has not pre‑committed to more hikes, its latest forecasts show core inflation still at 2.3% in 2028, up from a June estimate of 2.2%, implying that bringing inflation back to the 2% target in the medium term may still require additional rate rises.

JPMorgan Private Bank (JPM‑US) macro investment strategist Patrick Ernst said a rate hike before year‑end is no longer a low‑probability risk. The renewed escalation of the Middle‑East conflict has pushed oil and gas prices sharply higher, U.S. Treasuries have been sold off, and market expectations for continued tightening by major central banks have risen in tandem.

Ernst added that the ECB’s move was in line with expectations, but the crucial point is that the policy statement still leaves room for further tightening, showing that inflation risks from energy remain. “This hike is not a ceiling on rates,” he said, and the path forward will depend heavily on geopolitical developments.

S&P Global Ratings (SPGI‑US) Europe, Middle East and Africa chief economist Sylvain Broyer also said the hike is more than a precautionary step. Europe’s inflation outlook worsened over the summer, with both supply shocks intensifying and demand increasingly likely to push prices up, so the ECB may have to lift rates to a restrictive level and cannot rule out further hikes at this stage.

Schroders global economics head David Rees took a more cautious view. He noted that higher energy prices will keep overall inflation elevated, but core inflation is still under control and domestic demand is weakening; the simultaneous rise in energy costs and financing costs could further suppress euro‑area growth, with the impact especially pronounced in 2027.

Rees argued that although the ECB’s statement and forecasts lean hawkish, the threshold for another hike remains high, and this move looks more like the last hike of the current cycle rather than the start of a prolonged tightening period. Unless growth and inflation accelerate markedly again, markets should not assume rates will march toward 3%.

Quilter Cheviot fixed‑income research head Richard Carter said the ECB’s balancing act is becoming increasingly tricky. Growth remains fragile in parts of the euro area, and policymakers must weigh curbing inflation against avoiding further damage to the economy. Stagnating inflation has not yet become a baseline scenario, but the combination of weakening growth and rekindling inflation pressures is becoming harder to ignore.

Aviva Investors rates head Ed Hutchings said the ECB’s immediate priority is indeed to rein in inflation, so market expectations of further hikes are not unfounded. However, after two hikes already and market pricing in more than two additional moves, investors’ tightening bets may have gone too far.

Fidelity International euro‑area economist Conor Parle warned that rising natural‑gas and fuel prices will make the ECB watch closely for any spread of price pressures. Recent heatwaves and supply‑chain issues could lift food inflation, and wage‑tracking indicators show a slight acceleration in pay growth, prompting policymakers to watch for early signs that the energy shock is spilling over into other price categories.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯力道轉強 貶值4.3分收在31.548元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar Buying Pressure Strengthens, Depreciates 4.3 Cents to Close at 31.548
paras: 新台幣今(10)日升貶互見，午盤過後貶勢擴大，終場收在31.548元，貶值4.3分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值放大至19.39億美元。
新台幣今以31.53元、貶值2.5分開出後，雖一度來到31.49元，但隨後買匯力道轉強，午盤後新台幣越走越低，最低來到31.581元，全日高低價差9.1分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元貶值近0.2%，新台幣收貶0.14%，泰銖貶近0.1%，日元和星元貶0.05%左右，人民幣平盤附近波動，而美元指數小跌0.05%，市場瀰漫高度觀望聯準會動態的氣氛。
國泰證期研究部指出，台灣 8 月出口年增 41%，金額創單月新高，AI 需求支撐半導體與伺服器營收展望，惟傳產復甦不均，成本壓力仍須關注，大額貿易順差則有利支撐台幣匯率。
統一投顧則分析，台股基本面支撐力道極強，8 月AI 伺服器供應鏈 8 月營收全數締造新猷，展現強韌獲利動能，緊接著輝達管理層出席高盛科技大會，有望釋出下一階段 AI 需求的樂觀展望，惟地緣政治與油價、債市風暴未歇，短線盤面難免受到牽制。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed mixed movement today (the 10th), with depreciation expanding after the midday session and closing at 31.548, a loss of 4.3 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms saw transaction volume rise to US$1.939 billion.

The NTD opened at 31.53, down 2.5 cents, briefly fell to 31.49, but buying pressure soon strengthened. After the midday session the currency kept sliding, reaching a low of 31.581, with a total intraday range of 9.1 cents.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won weakened by about 0.2%, the NTD fell 0.14%, the Thai baht slipped nearly 0.1%, the Japanese yen and Singapore dollar each lost roughly 0.05%, the Chinese yuan hovered near flat, and the U.S. dollar index slipped 0.05% as markets remained highly cautious about Federal Reserve moves.

Citi Securities’ research team noted that Taiwan’s August exports grew 41% year‑on‑year, hitting a record monthly total. AI demand underpins a positive outlook for semiconductor and server revenues, though recovery in traditional industries is uneven and cost pressures remain a concern. A large trade surplus, however, supports the NTD’s exchange rate.

Unified Investment Advisory analyzed that Taiwan’s equity fundamentals are very strong, with AI‑related server supply‑chain revenues in August all hitting new highs, demonstrating robust profit momentum. Following Nvidia’s management appearance at the Goldman Sachs Technology Conference, optimism about the next phase of AI demand is expected. Nevertheless, geopolitical tensions, oil price volatility, and turmoil in the bond market persist, keeping short‑term market moves constrained.

items.title: 貝森特自稱莊家 對日元與美股意味著什麼？
items.title_en: Biden Claims to Be the House: What It Means for the Yen and US Stocks
paras: 美國財長貝森特向來直言不諱，但他周二晚間在南方衛理公會大學商學院發表的談話，可能是其從政以來態度最強硬的一次。
貝森特談到的，不只是美國財政部近期為支撐日元所採取的干預行動，也包括美方在阿根廷上次大選前，為穩定披索所做的努力。
曾任總體經濟交易員的貝森特表示：「每當有人說，『財長這是在冒險』，我要說，這正是我夢寐以求的局面。我掌握不對稱資訊，現在莊家是我。」
他接著說：「因此，當我們出手干預日元時，我非常清楚日本政府、日本央行及日本決策官員接下來會怎麼做。你想跟我對賭，儘管來。」
到目前為止，美方的外匯干預已取得成效；相較之下，財政部宣布將買進長天期美債後，殖利率僅短暫回落。貝森特介入債市的做法，也遭到其恩師、知名投資人德魯肯米勒（Stanley Druckenmiller）批評。
美日聯手干預前，美元兌日元一度逼近164，目前已回落至約153，最新跌幅約0.32%。
高盛分析師普里沃羅茨基（Rich Privorotsky）在報告中指出，貝森特這番談話帶來的次級效應，才是影響股市的關鍵。市場擔心，隨著日元升值，原本借入低利率日元、再投入其他資產的投資人，將不得不縮減甚至完全平倉，亦即所謂的日元套利交易可能加速退場。
普里沃羅茨基表示：「當以日元融資的套利交易解除，資金回流日本債券與股票時，市場會發生什麼事？」他指出，標普500指數和大型科技股近期在缺乏明顯基本面利空的情況下，走勢卻異常沉重。值得留意的是，部分槓桿與套利部位可能正逐步從市場消退。
瑞銀全球財富管理首席經濟學家唐納文（Paul Donovan）則表示：「只有當日元貶值是由投機因素造成時，賭場的比喻才成立。如果干預前的日元匯價是由基本面驅動，那麼更貼切、儘管較少人熟悉的比喻，應是英國1992年的匯率機制危機。在這種情況下，貝森特應該宣稱：『我就是拉蒙特。』」
拉蒙特（Norman Lamont）當時擔任英國財政大臣，曾試圖讓英國留在歐洲匯率機制內，但最終未能成功。
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Biden is known for speaking bluntly, but his remarks on Tuesday night at the Business School of Southern Methodist University may be the toughest stance he’s taken in his political career.
Biden discussed not only the Treasury’s recent intervention to support the yen, but also US efforts to stabilize the peso before Argentina’s last election.

Former macro trader Biden said, "Whenever someone says, 'The Treasury is taking a risk,' I reply that this is exactly the scenario I’ve dreamed of. I have asymmetric information, and now I am the house."
He added, "So when we intervene in the yen, I know exactly what the Japanese government, the Bank of Japan and Japanese policymakers will do next. If you want to bet against me, go ahead."

So far the US foreign‑exchange intervention has shown results; by contrast, after the Treasury announced it would buy long‑term US bonds, yields only fell briefly. Biden’s move into the bond market was also criticized by his mentor, famed investor Stanley Druckenmiller.
Before the US‑Japan joint intervention, the dollar‑yen rate briefly approached 164, now it has slipped to about 153, a recent decline of roughly 0.32%.

Goldman Sachs analyst Rich Privorotsky noted in a report that the secondary effects of Biden’s comments are the real driver for equities. The market worries that a stronger yen will force investors who borrowed cheap yen to fund other assets to unwind or fully close those positions, accelerating the exit of yen‑carry trades.

Privorotsky said, "When yen‑funded arbitrage unwinds and capital flows back into Japanese bonds and stocks, what will happen to the market?" He pointed out that the S&P 500 and large‑cap tech stocks have been unusually heavy despite a lack of clear fundamental downside, and that some leveraged and arbitrage positions may be gradually disappearing from the market.

UBS Global Wealth Management chief economist Paul Donovan said, "The casino analogy only holds if yen depreciation is driven by speculation. If the pre‑intervention yen rate was fundamentally driven, a more apt, though less familiar, comparison is the 1992 UK exchange‑rate mechanism crisis. In that case, Biden should claim: 'I am Lamont.'"
Norman Lamont was the UK Chancellor at the time who tried to keep Britain in the European Exchange Rate Mechanism but ultimately failed.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Shows Minor Fluctuations, Market Focuses on Central Bank Meetings
paras: 美元周三(9日)變動不大，市場焦點持續落在近期大幅走強的日元。外匯市場參與者正為關鍵的時刻做準備，歐洲央行(ECB)本周將公布利率決議，聯準會(Fed)與日本銀行(BoJ)將於下周公布決策。
美國公債市場同樣受關注，財政部公布備受期待的公債回購操作更新後，規模令投資人失望。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報98.83。
美國財政部宣布將回購60億美元、到期年限10年至20年的美國公債，高於先前的20億美元，消息公布後市場拋售美債，美國公債殖利率大幅上升。
美國財政部上月曾表示，將把公債回購規模提高至至少40億美元，但媒體報導此前市場預期規模至少會達到100億美元。
美國10年期公債殖利率上升3.5個基點至4.839%。在財政部公布消息前，殖利率僅上升1.2個基點至4.816%。對利率更加敏感的美國2年期公債殖利率則上升2.7個基點至4.425%。
財政部的回購行動原本被視為一項意外的干預措施，目的是限制美國公債殖利率持續飆升的走勢，而美債近期一直遭遇大規模拋售。
此次美債拋售受到多重因素推動，包括油價飆升引發的通膨疑慮、企業為支應人工智慧基礎建設而大舉發債所帶來的市場擔憂，以及對美國國債規模持續膨脹的疑慮。
布魯金斯研究院經濟研究資深研究員Robin Brooks表示，「試圖透過公債回購等方式，人為壓低長期殖利率的問題在於，如果市場認為回購規模太小，殖利率反而會跳升。這顯示市場底層的上行壓力非常強勁。」
目前市場正密切等待周四公布的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)及周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，以尋找進一步的利率線索。如果通膨數據高於預期，可能使市場對聯準會下周升息的預期明顯升溫。
日元持續徘徊逾七個月高點
日元已成為主要貨幣中表現最亮眼貨幣，光是9月以來就上漲4%。本月初開始的強勁漲勢，周二一度推動日元升至152.89兌1美元的高點。周三日元延續升勢，美元兌日元下跌0.2%，至153.63。
日元受到日本銀行政策收緊預期及市場廣泛猜測日本政府可能再次干預匯市等因素支撐。金融市場幾乎已確定日本銀行將於9月18日升息25個基點，交易員也認為，日本銀行總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)可能暗示年底前還會進一步推動貨幣政策正常化。
LPL Financial技術策略師Adam Turnquist周二表示，「日元的漲勢反映出基本面與技術面真正發生轉變，日銀正進一步走向政策正常化，同時突破原有趨勢。投資人應密切關注152這個關鍵價位，若日元明確突破該支撐並進一步升值，可能加速日元漲勢、迫使更多空頭回補，並重新引發日元套利交易平倉的風險，進而對包括美國公債在內的全球資產產生連鎖影響。」
本周稍早公布的官方數據顯示，日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元。外匯存底的大幅下降，直接為東京規模達15兆日元(976.7億美元)的匯市干預行動提供資金，其中部分行動是與美國同步進行。
其他貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1629美元。
歐洲央行幾乎已被市場一致預期，周四將升息25個基點。
德意志銀行Jim Reid表示，「市場確實可以討論，在供給衝擊之下，歐洲央行是否應該繼續升息……但市場顯然認為，央行的政策反應函數與能源價格高度相關，近期油價與天然氣價格上漲，使市場對最終利率的定價達到3%。」
他補充，「因此，明天升息基本上已經確定，但接下來的情況就會變得更加複雜。如果能源價格維持在目前水準，經濟成長應該會受到影響，但到目前為止，實際影響遠沒有市場原先預期的那麼大，因此歐洲央行面臨的高度不確定性必須受到重視。」

paras_en: The dollar changed little on Wednesday (the 9th), with market attention still on the yen, which has surged sharply in recent weeks. Forex participants are preparing for a pivotal moment as the European Central Bank (ECB) will announce its rate decision this week, and the Federal Reserve (Fed) and Bank of Japan (BoJ) will release their decisions next week.
The U.S. Treasury market is also in focus; after the Treasury released an eagerly awaited update on its bond repurchase operations, the size disappointed investors.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 98.83.

The U.S. Treasury announced a repurchase of $6 billion of Treasury bonds with maturities of 10 to 20 years, higher than the previously announced $2 billion. After the news, the market sold off Treasuries, and Treasury yields jumped sharply.
Last month the Treasury said it would raise the repurchase size to at least $4 billion, but media reports noted that the market had previously expected the size to be at least $10 billion.

The 10‑year Treasury yield rose 3.5 basis points to 4.839%. Before the Treasury’s announcement, the yield had risen only 1.2 basis points to 4.816%. The more rate‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield climbed 2.7 basis points to 4.425%.
The repurchase action was originally seen as an unexpected intervention aimed at curbing the continued surge in Treasury yields, as Treasuries have recently faced large‑scale selling.

The recent Treasury sell‑off was driven by multiple factors, including inflation worries sparked by soaring oil prices, market concerns over corporations issuing massive debt to fund AI infrastructure, and doubts about the ever‑expanding size of U.S. government debt.

Robin Brooks, senior economist at the Brookings Institution, said, "The problem with trying to artificially lower long‑term yields through repurchases is that if the market thinks the repurchase size is too small, yields can actually jump. This shows that the underlying upward pressure in the market is very strong."

The market is now closely awaiting Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) and Friday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) for further rate clues. If inflation data comes in hotter than expected, expectations for a Fed rate hike next week could rise sharply.
The yen continues to hover near a seven‑month high.

The yen has become the best‑performing major currency, up 4% since September. A strong rally that began early this month pushed the yen to a high of 152.89 per dollar on Tuesday. On Wednesday the yen kept climbing, with USD/JPY down 0.2% to 153.63.

The yen is being supported by expectations of tighter Bank of Japan policy and widespread speculation that the Japanese government may intervene in the FX market again. The financial markets are almost certain that the BoJ will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 18, and traders also think BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda may hint at further policy normalization before year‑end.

Adam Turnquist, technology strategist at LPL Financial, said on Tuesday, "The yen’s rally reflects a real shift in fundamentals and technicals, with the BoJ moving further toward policy normalization and breaking its previous trend. Investors should watch the key level of 152 closely; if the yen decisively breaks that support and appreciates further, it could accelerate the rally, force more short covering, and reignite the risk of yen‑carry‑trade unwind, which could have cascading effects on global assets, including U.S. Treasuries."

Official data released earlier this week showed that Japan’s August foreign‑securities holdings fell by a record $87.8 billion. The sharp drop in foreign‑exchange reserves directly funds Tokyo’s ¥15 trillion (about $97.67 billion) FX‑intervention capacity, some of which is coordinated with the United States.
Among other currencies, the euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1629.
The ECB is almost unanimously expected by the market to raise rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, "The market can indeed discuss whether, under a supply shock, the ECB should keep raising rates… but the market clearly sees the ECB’s policy response function as highly linked to energy prices. Recent spikes in oil and gas have pushed market pricing of the final rate to about 3%."

He added, "Therefore, a rate hike tomorrow is basically a given, but what follows will become more complex. If energy prices stay at current levels, economic growth should be affected, but so far the real impact has been far less than markets originally expected, so the high uncertainty facing the ECB must be taken seriously."

items.title: 日元強勢反攻！日本升息恐掀套利交易平倉 美股、AI科技股小心了
items.title_en: Yen’s Strong Rebound! Japan Rate Hike Could Trigger Arbitrage Unwinding, Watch US Stocks and AI Tech Shares
paras: 日元近期大幅升值，兌美元價位從160一路升破153，然而策略師警告，若日元繼續走強並造成「套利交易」快速平倉，可能引發股市拋售，而高估值的美國科技股將首當其衝。
多年來，華爾街交易員熱愛能「輕鬆賺錢」的「日元套利交易」：以近乎零利率的成本在日本借錢，再把資金投入其他市場追逐更高報酬，主要流向美股市場。
但這項押注如今面臨瓦解風險，近期日元兌美元大幅升值，加上市場普遍預期日本銀行(BOJ, 央行)下周升息，可能重創這項廣受歡迎的交易策略。
日元周二(8日)延續兌美元升勢，盤中一度升破153，最高報152.89日元兌1美元，創2月以來最強。
市場預期日銀下周將大幅升息，成為推動日元上漲的主要動力。市場也開始揣測，日本當局可能再次低調干預外匯市場，以抑制日元近期跌勢。
日元兌美元上周已跌破160整數關卡。160通常被視為關鍵門檻，日元一旦升至這一水準，日本政府干預匯市的可能性將提高。根據FactSet數據，日元兌美元9月迄今已升值近4%。
在此背景下，市場動能可能讓股市投資人暴露在一項意料之外的衝擊中：日元持續升值，進而引發套利交易快速平倉。
所謂套利交易，是指投資人以較低利率借入資金，再投入可能帶來較高報酬的資產。日元套利交易則是借入低收益的日元，買進收益率較高的美元，再將美元投入美國資產，例如科技股。
舉例來說，1年期日本政府公債殖利率約1.55%，1年期美國國庫券殖利率約4.12%，兩者相差約2.57個百分點。換句話說，日元套利交易可藉由這項利差提高投資報酬。
但這項交易也可能以同樣強大的力量反向運作。如果日元突然進一步升值，就像近幾天的走勢一樣，投資人可能被迫迅速解除套利部位。這意味著投資人可能必須賣出以美元計價的資產，再將資金換回日元，以償還以日元計價的借款。
市場不久前就曾承受這種痛楚。2024年夏季日元大幅升值，引發股市震盪，套利交易平倉尤其威脅當時漲勢凌厲的美國科技股。
如今外匯市場可能再次具備類似條件。市場預期日銀將升息，而單是升息預期本身就可能進一步推升日元。
Swissquote資深分析師Ipek Ozkardeskaya表示，這類套利交易平倉「可能對AI／科技股族群造成尤其嚴重的衝擊」，因為高估值與部位過度集中，可能放大潛在的拋售壓力。
她指出，這將為逢低買進創造機會，因為套利交易平倉不會永遠持續，但短期內——可能持續數周，投資人將感受到壓力。
不過，Clocktower Group首席市場策略師Eric Wallerstein認為，這一次日元套利交易出現系統性平倉的可能性不高，因為交易員大多已經預期日元今年還會進一步升值。因此，日元若再突然升值，較不容易讓交易員措手不及，這或許足以避免出現恐慌性的大規模平倉。
Wallerstein表示，只要日本利率仍遠低於全球其他地區，「套利交易就仍會存在」。但若要重演幾年前出現的劇烈震盪，日元必須出現「幅度大且出乎意料」的升值。
2024年夏季套利交易平倉期間，日元兌美元在短短兩個月內升值13%。相比之下，這一次自7月底美元兌日元匯率觸及高點以來，美元兌日元匯率貶值不到6%。
paras_en: The yen has surged sharply lately, climbing from around 160 per dollar to break below 153, but strategists warn that if the yen keeps strengthening and forces a rapid unwind of “arbitrage trades,” it could spark a stock‑market sell‑off, with over‑valued US tech stocks hit first.

For years Wall Street traders have loved the easy‑money “yen arbitrage” play: borrow at near‑zero rates in Japan and deploy the funds into other markets for higher returns, mainly flowing into US equities.

That bet now faces collapse risk as the yen has appreciated sharply against the dollar and markets broadly expect the Bank of Japan to raise rates next week, which could cripple this popular strategy.
The yen continued its rise against the dollar on Tuesday the 8th, briefly breaking the 153 level and peaking at ¥152.89 per $1, its strongest since February.

Markets anticipate a sizable BOJ rate hike next week, the main driver behind the yen’s climb, and are also speculating that Japanese authorities may quietly intervene in FX to curb the yen’s recent rally.

Last week the yen fell below the round‑number barrier of 160 per dollar. The 160 level is seen as a key threshold; once the yen reaches it, the likelihood of government FX intervention rises. FactSet data shows the yen has appreciated about 4% against the dollar so far in September.
Against this backdrop, market momentum could expose equity investors to an unexpected shock: a continuously strengthening yen that triggers a rapid unwind of arbitrage positions.

Arbitrage trades involve borrowing at low rates and investing in higher‑yielding assets. Yen arbitrage means borrowing cheap yen, buying higher‑yielding dollars, and deploying those dollars into US assets such as tech stocks.

For example, the 1‑year Japanese government bond yields about 1.55% while the 1‑year US Treasury yields about 4.12%, a spread of roughly 2.57 percentage points, allowing yen arbitrage to boost investment returns.

But the same mechanism can work in reverse. If the yen suddenly appreciates further, as it has in recent days, investors may be forced to unwind arbitrage positions quickly, selling dollar‑denominated assets and converting the proceeds back to yen to repay yen‑denominated loans.
The market felt this pain not long ago. In the summer of 2024 a sharp yen rally rattled equities, and the unwinding of arbitrage trades especially threatened the then‑soaring US tech sector.
Now the FX market may again present similar conditions. Expectations of a BOJ rate hike alone could further lift the yen.
Swissquote senior analyst Ipek Ozkardeskaya said such arbitrage unwinds “could hit AI/tech stocks especially hard” because high valuations and concentrated positions can amplify sell‑pressure.
She added that this could create buying opportunities on dips, since arbitrage unwinds won’t last forever, but in the short term—potentially for several weeks—investors will feel the strain.

However, Clocktower Group chief market strategist Eric Wallerstein believes the chance of a systemic unwind this time is low, as traders largely anticipate further yen gains this year, making a sudden move less likely to catch them off guard and possibly averting panic‑driven mass unwinds.

Wallerstein noted that as long as Japanese rates remain far below those elsewhere, “arbitrage trades will persist.” Yet to repeat the severe volatility seen a few years ago, the yen would need to appreciate “dramatically and unexpectedly.”

During the summer 2024 unwind, the yen rose 13% against the dollar in just two months. By contrast, since the end of July when the USD/JPY peaked, the dollar has depreciated less than 6% against the yen.
